sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice M.I.Arun
 Oral Order
The writ petition is filed by Karnataka Housing Board.

In the preliminary notification, it is
mentioned that the lands have been acquired for the purpose of Karnataka Nc: 2024:Khc:32752
Housing Board.

The compensation has been determined by the Special Land Acquisition Officer in
respect of the lands acquired.

Not satisfied by the same, at the request of respondent No.1, the
matter was referred to the reference Court under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and
compensation has been enhanced.

While doing so, the reference Court has not issued the notice to
the petitioner- Karnataka Housing Board.

On the ground that it is mandatory as per Section 20 of
the Land Acquisition Act that, a notice has to be issued to the beneficiary

, the present writ petition is
filed.
2. Section 20 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1984 reads as under:
"20. Service of notice. - The Court shall thereupon cause a notice specifying the day
on which the Court will proceed to determine the objection, and directing their
appearance before the Court on that day, to be served on the following persons,
namely:-
Karnataka Housing Board vs Gavirangaiah on 14 August, 2024

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65043356/
2

 (a) the applicant;
 (b) all persons interested in the objection,
except such (if any) of them as have Nc: 2024:Khc:32752 consented without protest
to receive payment of the compensation awarded; and
(c) in the objection is in regard to the area of the land or to the amount of the
compensation, the Collector.
State Amendments Karnataka.

- In Section 20, -
(1) for the words "determine the objection", substitute the words "determine the
reference";
(2) for clauses (a), (b) and (c), substitute the following clauses, namely:-
"(a) the Deputy Commissioner;
(b) all persons interested in the reference; and
(c) if the acquisition is not made for Government, the person or authority for whom it
is made."
[Vide Mysore Act 17 of 1961, sec.22 (w.e.f. 24-8- 1961].
(3) for the work "Collector", substitute the words "Deputy Commissioner".

[Vide Mysore Act 17 of 1961, sec.4 (w.e.f. 24-8- 1961]"
Nc: 2024:Khc:32752
3.

Thus, when the acquisition is not made for the common, but for the benefit of a specific person or
authority, then, in that event, the beneficiary has to be issued notice and heard when compensation
is being determined by the reference Court.

4. The writ petition has to be allowed on the ground that the petitioner herein was not made as a
party before the reference Court.

5. Hence, the following:
Order
(i) The writ petition is allowed.
